evidence.reason: At the pinned tip, `JournalEventSchema` is a `z.union` that includes `JournalEventV1V2Schema` plus the v3 carriers (`RunStartedV3JournalEventSchema`, `AttemptFinishedJournalEventSchema`, `GateVerdictJournalEventSchema`, `TaskFinishedJournalEventSchema`, and the other v3 observational/decision carriers). The append/writer path remains on `JournalEventV1V2Schema`, which still rejects v3-shaped records. The requested reader-union change is therefore present; it was addressed in the review-fix commit `d3f653c06bcc736c83b8451e66e862e36f4ea2e4`.
